lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two routes lead out of Meridian.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: The Long Dark runs east. Slow, empty, no Weave sightings. We'd lose them in a week.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: And west is Ashfall Outpost. A mining station, fourteen people. Captain... it's transmitting.

lines.speaker: mimic
lines.text: Ashfall Outpost to any human ship. This is Warden Cole. Our hull is open. Our people are... we are fourteen. Please come. We have room for you.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: That's a distress call. A bad one.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Odd phrasing. "We have room for you."

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: People in shock say odd things, Hollis.

options.label: West to Ashfall: answer the distress call
East into the Long Dark: keep the fleet safe

then.speaker: sparrow_pilot
then.text: Captain... you heard the call. Fourteen people.

then.speaker: engineer
then.text: We couldn't reach Finch, Wren or Kite in time. We can still reach Ashfall.

then.speaker: li
then.text: I know you're trying to protect us. I love that about you. But not while people are dying, Vey.

then.speaker: engineer
then.text: The Long Dark isn't going anywhere. Ashfall might be.

then.speaker: tern_pilot
then.text: ...And the eastern relay just dropped. The Long Dark's nav signal is gone. We couldn't fly it blind if we wanted to.
